style: Photorealistic landscape, a red banded-rock gorge with a tall waterfall pouring into an emerald pool, warm late-afternoon light
continuity: the framing, horizon and every landmark remain fixed and the scene settles into the framing shown in Picture 2 at the end of the shot, matching the first frame so the clip can loop.
ambience: the steady roar of a waterfall echoing in a rock gorge

segments.camera: The camera holds a locked-off static wide shot.
segments.action: The waterfall pours steadily into the emerald pool, white spray drifts upward at its base, and gentle ripples spread across the pool toward the camera. Spinifex grass on the rocks sways slightly. The rock walls stay still.
segments.sfx: splashing water and soft trickling near the pool edge
